meta.semantics: Param-forwarding equivalence edges over direct call sites in decompile-results/full_export snapshot. P:FN2:K == P:FN1:J when at a direct call FN2 inside FN1 the argument-prep sequence purely forwards FN1 incoming param slot J (arg_N/4 or numeric ebp+8..60 without ebp repoint) to FN2 arg K. K = push position from call (0=last), +2 for fastcall stack args; T:FN2 == P:FN1:J for ecx-forwarded thiscall. lea (out-param) never equated; any arithmetic/other def breaks the chain; barriers: jump-target labels, jcc/jmp, call, ret, non-staging instructions; register chase <=8 benign steps, mov r,[slot] or mov r,r2 (<=2 levels) only. Arity bounds collection (callee max retn N/4, fallback signals params); unknown arity => contiguous pushes only. Fastcall ecx/edx edges flagged via=pforward-fc. Each site emits independent edges (AND merge downstream). dup field marks overlap with param_usage_types_v2 PU1 (P->T) or callarg_origins (k<=16 quadruple heuristic, different P-namespace caveat).
meta.k_convention: P:fn:k k = stack-arg index (this excluded), IDA arg_N/4; same as param_usage_types_v2
